title.value: Book flights, groceries and restaurants with ChatGPT Agent

introduction.value:

method.value: The thread is mostly a negative test of ChatGPT Agent, but commenters describe a few successful transactions. One commenter said they sent the agent a screenshot of a friend’s flight confirmation, included their personal details in the first prompt, and the agent booked the same flight; the same commenter also said they ordered groceries on Instacart. Another commenter said it worked for a restaurant reservation.

outcome.value: Results were inconsistent: the original poster said shopping, travel, and reservations usually failed, while commenters reported isolated successes on flights, Instacart, and a restaurant booking. The post also says the tool hit a 40-query limit and could stall or fail on major sites.

notes.value: The clearest catch is reliability: even in this thread, success depended on the site and task, and the original poster says they ran out after 40 queries.

source_text.body:
Book flights, groceries and restaurants with ChatGPT Agent
Commenters report ChatGPT Agent booked a flight once given their information, ordered groceries on Instacart and made a restaurant reservation.
·
Jul 25, 2025
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The thread is mostly a negative test of ChatGPT Agent, but commenters describe a few successful transactions. One commenter said they sent the agent a screenshot of a friend’s flight confirmation, included their personal details in the first prompt, and the agent booked the same flight; the same commenter also said they ordered groceries on Instacart. Another commenter said it worked for a restaurant reservation.
How it went
Results were inconsistent: the original poster said shopping, travel, and reservations usually failed, while commenters reported isolated successes on flights, Instacart, and a restaurant booking. The post also says the tool hit a 40-query limit and could stall or fail on major sites.
Worth knowing
The clearest catch is reliability: even in this thread, success depended on the site and task, and the original poster says they ran out after 40 queries.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
I need to [book a flight from [origin] to [destination] on [dates] / order groceries on Instacart from [store] / reserve a table at a [cuisine] restaurant in [city] for [number] people on [date and time]]. Find the best options within [budget or preferences] and pick the top choice. Pause before entering payment details or confirming anything, and show me exactly what you're about to book or buy.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1m9bv7d/i_tested_openais_20month_agent_so_you_dont_have
